verdict.rationale: dlt's core function is moving many records at once: it loads whole lists of records or entire SQL tables and file sets into destinations [dlt-docs-7, dlt-docs-24, dlt-docs-39]. It also applies set-level write modes, merge/upsert with deduplication and full-load replace, across all loaded data [dlt-docs-18, dlt-docs-49], and dltHub lets teams schedule, backfill and chain pipelines [dlt-docs-59]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk actions across many pipelines or resources at once (e.g., an agent or MCP tool acting on many items in one call), and independent hands-on evidence of large-scale bulk behavior or limits.
